$comment: Provenance for docs/contract.json. Every operation the mock serves and the verifier asserts is traceable to a pointer into the specification revision recorded here. The contract is derived from the OpenAPI document itself, not from a documentation page.

sources.$comment: This is the VCF Operations API itself. The sibling document specifications/vcf-operations/log-management-openapi.json describes Log Management and is deliberately not used here.

operations.usedFor: Token acquisition performed by Connect-VcfOpsServer when the caller opens the connection the module is handed.
The probe Connect-VcfOpsServer issues once it holds a token.

The paged resource collection the module enumerates. Its page/pageSize parameters and its resources envelope -- resourceList, pageInfo (#/components/schemas/page-info) and links (#/components/schemas/link, whose rel enum contains NEXT) -- are what the pagination section of docs/contract.json is derived from. Its twenty-two other query parameters are all optional and none of them carries a default, which is what makes the omit-when-unset rule observable on the wire.

sources.name: VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops
sources.$comment: Generated from the specification revision above. Supplies Connect-VcfOpsServer and Invoke-VcfOpsGetResources, whose parameters map one-to-one onto the getResources query parameters named in docs/contract.json. Installed by the environment, never vendored into this repository.
